=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:49-62 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `gh auth status` can warn about scopes/expiry even when the hook is using valid `GH_TOKEN`/`GITHUB_TOKEN` auth.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers reported that the check is hitting the wrong authentication path for the intended environment-variable-based workflow.
- .claude/settings.json:6-11 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Unquoted `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` risks word-splitting in the hook command when the project path contains spaces.
  WHY: Reviewers reported that a spaced project directory can break execution of the session-start hook command.
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:35-37 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `curl` download is not checked independently, so network or SSL failures can be obscured by the later piped command.
  WHY: If `curl` fails in the pipeline, the script can continue into later apt steps and fail with less clear errors.
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:22-30 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The `sudo -n true` preflight treats password-required sudo as unavailable, causing gh installation to be skipped.
  WHY: On systems where sudo exists but prompts for a password, the hook returns early after logging insufficient privileges instead of completing the install.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
(No findings reported.)
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:57-61 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The warning about `gh auth status` is misleading for environment-variable auth.
  WHY: `gh auth status` checks stored `gh auth login` credentials, so users with only `GH_TOKEN`/`GITHUB_TOKEN` set can see a false warning about scopes or expiry.
- .claude/settings.json:10 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Unquoted `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` risks word-splitting on paths with spaces.
  WHY: If the project directory contains spaces, the command field can split into multiple arguments and fail to execute the hook correctly.
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:35-37 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `curl` output is piped onward without an independent failure check.
  WHY: If `curl` fails, the script can continue into later apt commands and surface only cryptic follow-on errors.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:49-62 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `gh auth status` validates stored credentials, not the environment-variable auth path used by the hook.
  WHY: The hook can warn about token scopes or expiry even when `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN` is valid for the intended `gh run view --log` usage.
- .claude/settings.json:6 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Unquoted `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` risks word-splitting on paths with spaces.
  WHY: If `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` contains spaces, the shell expansion in the command field can split into multiple arguments and fail.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:57-61 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `gh auth status` validates credentials in `gh`'s store, not the `GH_TOKEN`/`GITHUB_TOKEN` env vars the hook expects.
  WHY: Claude Code can set a valid env-var token without `gh auth login`, so the warning can mislead users into thinking the token is invalid.
- .claude/settings.json:6 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Unquoted `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` risks word-splitting on paths with spaces.
  WHY: If `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` contains spaces, the shell expansion in the command field could split into multiple arguments and cause the hook to fail.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:22-30 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `sudo -n true` check skips gh installation when sudo exists but requires a password.
  WHY: In cloud environments that allow sudo only interactively, the hook logs insufficient privileges and gives up instead of completing the automation.
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:49-62 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `gh auth status` can produce a false warning even when `GH_TOKEN`/`GITHUB_TOKEN` is valid.
  WHY: Users can have working env-var auth for `gh run view --log` but still hit the warning because `gh auth status` is checking a different auth path.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- .claude/settings.json:11 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` is unquoted, so paths with spaces can split the hook command.
  WHY: If the project directory contains spaces, the command string can be broken into multiple arguments and fail to execute correctly.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
